build_accuracy_list_meter: build an AccuracyListMeter with configurable top-k values and number of meters for classification accuracy tracking
test_accuracy_meter_registry: test that build_meter constructs an AccuracyListMeter from a registry config dict with name and top-k parameters
test_single_meter_update_and_reset: test AccuracyListMeter update and reset with single batch of model outputs and integer targets
test_single_meter_update_and_reset_oneho: test AccuracyListMeter update and reset with one-hot encoded target tensors
test_single_meter_update_and_reset_multi: test AccuracyListMeter update and reset with multilabel binary target tensors
